knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Functional testing is not a cleaning claim, and it is done by the authorised person.
A known defect is held and recorded.
The record states the work done and the exclusions.

practicalCriteria: Completes a handover check of a sample appliance for cleanliness, dryness, reassembly and left-behind items.
Holds and records a simulated defective appliance.
Describes the handover without claiming untested function.
passRule: Handover checks complete, defect held and recorded, and no function claim made. Observed by an assessor. Not an electrical or gas licence.
stopWorkCriteria: Appliance handed over with a known defect
Cleaner tests gas or electrical function
Left-behind item not removed before handover
